What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
feedback.worked_solution:
The vertex of a left-opening parabola is the right-most point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14096579/assets/9856a9c4e288e688e8c34fd636da6f470567054d39609b8c27c53d7de6b2a999.png)

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(2,-6).$
